name: Ka'ana Resort
positioning: Intimate boutique hotel on the edge of the wilderness in San Ignacio, in Belize's Cayo District, at the doorstep of the Maya temple of Xunantunich
best_for: Travelers who want a base for Maya ruins, caves and jungle excursions
Couples looking for a villa with a private plunge pool and a spa rooted in Maya traditions

facts.text: Ka'ana is a boutique hotel in San Ignacio, in Belize's Cayo District, set on the edge of the wilderness.
The name Ka'ana means 'heavenly place' in the ancient Maya language.
The resort has an organic on-site garden.
Ool Spa is an intimate spa surrounded by tropical gardens, using local botanicals and Mayan healing techniques.
Spa scrubs and wraps use regional ingredients like cacao, coffee, sugar and local herbs.
Each evening there is a fireside campfire with roasted marshmallows.
The Wallace Bar is on site, alongside farm-to-table dining.
Tours and excursions are arranged by the resort's Guest Experience Team.
Guided horseback rides include a ride to Xunantunich after crossing the Mopan River on a hand-cranked ferry.
Excursions include the ATM cave in the Tapir Mountain Nature Reserve, reached by a 45-minute trek that includes wading across 3 rivers.
In the Maya Cooking Class, guests cook classic dishes like tamales, corn tortillas and caldo on a fogon, an authentic Maya stove.

highlights.text: The resort sits at the doorstep of Xunantunich, the ancient Maya temple.
The resort offers Signature Villas in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts.
Spa treatments can be taken in indoor treatment rooms or in outdoor settings across the property, including under the jungle canopy.
Amenities include an infinity swimming pool and private plunge pools.
Sunrise yoga classes are held on a dedicated jungle platform or at nearby Mayan temples.

considerations.text: Spa slots fill up quickly in peak season, so booking 24 to 48 hours ahead is highly recommended.
WhataHotel notes that the remote jungle location requires planning for outside activities.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and shopping options in the immediate area.
